_comment: Temporary Claude Code settings for the hook-chain-semantics experiment. Place the file at .claude/settings.json inside a throwaway project directory, then open it with Claude Code and run a single `ls` command. The three hooks h1/h2/h3 will fire simultaneously. Observe /tmp/claude-chain-test.log for interleaving and /tmp/claude-chain-test-h3-ran for h3's marker. Restore your real settings.json afterwards.
